verdict.rationale: The firm's own Lowenstein x Clerky page publicly lists pay-per-use prices for a formation workflow ($299 Post-Incorporation Setup, $149 managed 83(b) add-on) and a Company Lifetime Package. That is real published pricing, but only for one narrow productized offering, likely platform-mediated. Missing for 10: hourly rate structures, alternative fee arrangement disclosures, general billing practices for core practice engagements, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm states publicly how engagements are priced — rate structures, alternative fee arrangements, or billing practices — rather than leaving cost entirely opaque

citations.quote: Post-Incorporation Setup also captures founder specific vesting and IP details and is $299 on pay per use or included with the Company Lifetime Package
a managed 83(b) election add on is available for $149.
